description: A channel-based messaging and collaboration platform for team communication, app integration, and AI agents.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for public apps; individual bot tokens (xoxb-) and user tokens for workspace apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Slack account and create apps self-serve via the Slack API dashboard at no cost.
api_notes: Comprehensive Web API covering messaging, channels, users, files, reactions, workflows, and an official MCP server for agentic interaction.
mcp_notes: Official Slack Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provided by Slack at https://mcp.slack.com/mcp for connecting AI agents.
rationale: Slack provides extensive public APIs, self-serve free app creation, and an official remote MCP server making it immediately ready for agent toolkits.

evidence.note: Details OAuth 2.0 and token management for Slack apps.
Allows developers to sign in and create apps self-serve.
Documents Web API methods, Events API, and developer tools.
Provides the official Slack MCP server URL and connection instructions for AI tools.
